summary_md: This looks high-impact (auth/payments/sends/migrations). The lane planned it but paused for your go before doing anything. Plan: ## Plan for ARCA-61 (no code changes made — investigation only)  ### What I found I traced the full path: `WatchlistPage.tsx` → `client/src/lib/api.ts` → `/api/watchlist` → `modules/watchlist/handlers.ts` → `db/auth.ts` (SQLite sessions).  The watchlist ownership/scoping code itself looks correct: - Every watchlist route is gated by inline auth middleware that resolves the session cookie to a `userId` and scopes all reads/writes by `user_id`. - No localStorage/anonymous fallback exists for watchlist data (only theme prefs use localStorage). - No hardcoded/default `watchlist_id`; sess
